messages.content: An archive keeps a chronological list of revisions to a small operating schedule. The original schedule named room Amber, start time 09:00, and a capacity of 12 seats. A later note was a tentative proposal for room Birch at 11:00 with 18 seats. Proposals are never binding. The next entry was approved and changed the room to Cedar and the starting time to 10:30, leaving capacity unchanged. The final approved entry raised capacity by four seats and made no other changes. An unsigned draft after that entry suggested going back to 09:00 and using room Ash. Unsigned drafts have no effect. Reconstruct the final approved schedule and return exactly one JSON object with keys room, start, seats. Preserve the capitalization of the room name and use a two-digit hour and minute for the start time.
